# Vyamit AI

Vyamit AI is a voice-first AI shop management platform built for Indian small businesses. It is designed for retail and wholesale shops that need fast billing, clear inventory control, customer ledger visibility, lending and credit tracking, GST-ready invoices, UPI-ready virtual bills, printer support, and business insights in one command center.

## Core product value

- Voice-first billing for counters and busy shop floors
- Inventory management and live stock awareness
- Customer ledger and amount due tracking
- Lending and credit tracking for shopkeepers
- GST-ready invoices and professional billing output
- UPI-ready virtual bills and digital record sharing
- Cloud history, business insights, and a modern mobile experience

## Who it is for

Kirana and grocery stores, pharmacies, dairy and bakery retailers, stationery stores, wholesalers, and other small businesses in India.

## Product approach

Shopkeepers can speak naturally in familiar languages and dialects. Vyamit AI is designed to recognise items and quantities, prepare bills, update connected records, and make business data easier to act on.
